shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures against a plain ground
curled/beaded hair or mane rendered as rows of tight curls
horizontal ground line / register base with a narrow patterned band
justification: Both are shallow profile reliefs on a plain ground with a horizontal baseline and share the convention of rendering hair or mane as dense rows of tight curls, plus a small band of repeating ornament along a lower edge. But A shows a file of upright standing human figures processing and carrying vessels toward a seated/standing dignitary, while B shows a large collapsed quadruped (a lion-like beast) sprawled with head down, so the subjects and their relationships are quite different.
